items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: And now with Dez Dims, you'd be working more than that. Oh, we worked every night... You see, Desdoin, he sort of gave a Piron competition for a while, you know, of course, he was Piron number two band for a while, you see.

ctx.x: And now with Dez Dims, you'd be working more than that. Oh, we worked every night.

Every night and then turned some new. Every night, yes, we had to turn them down. You see, Desdoin, he sort of gave a Piron competition for a while, you know, of course, he was Piron number two band for a while, you see.
